adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the create path wraps post/embed creation in `Topic.transaction`, but the update path (`else`) does `revisor.revise!` (which persists changes to the post) and only afterwards `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` without any transaction. If `revise!` succeeds and `update_column` fails/raises (DB error, connection issue, etc.), the post content is updated but `topic_embeds.content_sha1` remains stale, leaving the embed record inconsistent with the post content.
